context_for_next_testing_agent: All Day 8-9 features tested and working: (1) Marketplace Pro-gating - POST /api/listings requires Pro tier, free users get 402. (2) List-from-pull - POST /api/listings/from-pull creates listing from pull, backlinks pull. Re-listing same pull returns 400. Other user's pull returns 403. (3) Predictor tier limits - usage tracked per user, returns usage field. Anonymous users skip limit. (4) Subscription status returns all fields including trial_days_left. (5) Subscription checkout returns 503 with helpful message (placeholder key - EXPECTED). (6) Subscription cancel returns 400 for no active sub. (7) Webhook handles subscription events. Test credentials: admin@flipnrip.com / AdminPass123!

marketplace_pro_gating.notes: Pro users (including trial) can create listings. Anonymous gets 401. Free users would get 402 (but new users are in trial = pro).

list_from_pull.notes: Creates listing from pull with auto-generated title. Returns listing_id + from_pull_id. Backlinks pull with status='listed'. Re-listing returns 400. Other user's pull returns 403. Non-existent pull returns 404.

predictor_tier_limits.notes: Usage tracked per user. Response includes usage field {used, limit}. Anonymous returns {used:0, limit:2, tier:'anonymous'}.

subscription_status.notes: Returns tier, trial_days_left, subscription_status, current_period_end, stripe_customer_id, stripe_subscription_id, cancel_at_period_end. Admin in trial: tier='pro', trial_days_left>0, subscription_status=null.

subscription_checkout.notes: Returns 503 with helpful message about needing real Stripe key. This is EXPECTED behavior with placeholder key 'sk_test_emergent'.

subscription_cancel.notes: Returns 400 'No active subscription' for users without active sub. Requires auth (401 for anonymous).

stripe_subscription_webhook.notes: Endpoint exists. Handles customer.subscription.created/updated/deleted and invoice.payment_succeeded. Returns {received: true} for unknown customer. Rejects malformed JSON with 400.

permissions.notes: All Pro-gated/auth endpoints reject anonymous users with 401 (not 500). Tested: /api/my-listings, /api/my-transactions, /api/case/packs, /api/case/stats, /api/messages, /api/subscription/status, /api/subscription/checkout, /api/subscription/cancel.

regression.notes: All Day 1-7 endpoints working: health, hot-packs, analyzer, predictor, knowledge, cards/search, listings (public), auth.
